g.textArea: Five that would create a new category, and five that use the tools on the table in ways nobody expects. Same scores as before; totals are Claude's drafts.
g.text: A. Revolutionizing: a new category, not a better version of something that exists

#15 Deal room
Your agent and the tradesperson's agent negotiate the renovation contract, each with private limits. Humans only sign.

Apps and Agentic AI
+ NVIDIA challenge
Type your budget; two agents trade offers on screen for 20 seconds and land on a price, with both sides' reasons shown.
Judges ask why a tradesperson would run an agent. Answer: it stops them losing jobs to slow replies.

g.textArea: Two Nemotron agents, private state, Tavily prices

Every quote today is a slow email thread

Apps and Agentic AI
+ NVIDIA challenge
Push a commit that drops alt text; the pipeline fails, quotes the article of the law, and suggests the fix.

#17 Film a room, get a robot job
Phone video of a warehouse aisle; the VL model lists objects and hazards, Nemotron writes the task plan a robot can run.

Vertical AI
physical AI and robotics
+ NVIDIA challenge
Walk the phone through the venue's kitchen; 30 seconds later every object is labelled and a 'clear the table' plan appears step by step.
VL misses small objects. Demo on a tidy scene you filmed in advance.

Robot deployments start with a site survey
Scene to task spec is the missing step
Frames and VL are fine; skip the simulator

Patients type symptoms on a tablet before the doctor; the doctor gets a structured intake, and across clinics an outbreak shows early.

Vertical AI
healthcare and life sciences

Three fake patients type 'fever and rash'; the doctor's screen fills itself and a red dot grows on the Neukölln map.
Health data and GDPR. Nothing identifying leaves the clinic, and the screen says so.

Intake form plus a live city map

Text in, JSON out; simulate 200 patients

An agent interviews a leaving engineer, checks the repo and wiki for what's undocumented, and writes the handover nobody writes.

Apps and Agentic AI
+ NVIDIA challenge
Point it at a repo; it asks 'why is the retry limit 7 in payments.py?', you answer, and the handover doc grows live.
Needs a real repo with real quirks. Use one of yours, not a toy.

Every departure loses months of context
AI interviewing humans, not the reverse

#21 Docs to MCP
Point it at any API docs site; Tavily maps and extracts it, Nemotron writes an MCP server with typed tools, Serverless hosts it.

Apps and Agentic AI
+ NVIDIA challenge
Paste the Open-Meteo docs URL; 90 seconds later Claude Code asks for tomorrow's rain in Berlin through a server that didn't exist.
Generated servers break on auth and odd formats. Demo on one public API you tested.

Codegen is flaky; limit to REST with JSON

rect.data-content:
#22 Humans as tools
An MCP tool called ask_a_human: when the agent is unsure it messages a real person on Telegram, waits, and continues.

Apps and Agentic AI
+ NVIDIA challenge
The renovation agent hits 'which wall is load-bearing?', Ralph's phone buzzes, he replies, and the plan finishes.
Looks like a gimmick if the question is trivial. Make it one only a human can know.

g.textArea: MCP tool, Telegram bot, async wait, Nemotron
A phone buzzes mid-demo; the room gets it
Stops agents guessing on the one unknown
Inverts the usual human-in-the-loop
Telegram bots are 20 lines; loop is simple

rect.data-content:
#23 Distill on the day
Super writes 500 labelled examples for your task; a Serverless job fine-tunes a small open model; it deploys and matches Super at a fifth of the cost.

Cloud and Serverless
+ NVIDIA challenge
Pick a task; 500 examples stream past, the job runs, and a small model answers from a URL with the same score as Super.
The fine-tune doesn't finish. Kick one off at noon with a tiny set as insurance.

g.textArea: Synthetic data, fine-tune job, endpoint, eval
A chart and a URL; make the chart clear
Everyone wants Super quality at Nano prices
Distillation as a one-click product
Start the fine-tune by 13:00 or it won't finish

rect.data-content:
#24 Hold the line
An agent calls the Bürgeramt hotline for you, waits in the queue, and when a human answers it handles the request or rings you to take over.

Apps and Agentic AI
+ NVIDIA challenge
Dial a mentor's phone; the agent sits through a fake hold loop, then books an appointment with the mentor playing the clerk.
Never call a real public office from the stage. A mentor's phone is the office.

g.textArea: Twilio call, speech model on Serverless, Nemotron
A phone call on stage is unforgettable
Berlin's 115 line means long waits for everyone
Old telephony as the agent's interface
Telephony plus live speech is two risky parts

rect.data-content: What changes: #15 Deal room, #16 Law as CI and #22 Humans as tools tie with #2 at 18. #22 is as much a feature as an idea: bolt ask_a_human onto #3, #9 or #15 and it becomes the magic moment. #15 is the safest of the three to build. #16 is the most ambitious; only pick it if one of you knows GitHub Actions well. Bonus for tonight, 30 minutes: a judge simulator. Paste the assumed rubric and your demo script; five Nemotron personas score it and ask the Q&A questions. Rehearse against it before 09:00.
